description: This file contains unit tests for channel activity tracking functions, testing recording, retrieval, and resetting of channel activity timestamps.

methods.name: getChannelActivity
methods.description: Retrieves the last recorded inbound and outbound timestamps for a specified channel and account.

methods.name: recordChannelActivity
methods.description: Records an activity timestamp for a specific channel, account, and direction.

methods.name: resetChannelActivityForTest
methods.description: Resets the activity tracking state, typically used in tests to clear data.
